rules.name: High behavioural distance
rules.description: The completed window has a Phase 5 score of at least 0.50.

rules.name: Previously unseen shell execution
rules.description: A shell executable not present in the selected digest baseline executed.

rules.name: Novel root process
rules.description: A UID 0 process executed although UID 0 was absent from the baseline.

rules.name: Previously unseen dual-use tool
rules.description: A downloader, network utility, interpreter, or encoding tool absent from the baseline executed.

rules.name: Shell-to-tool sequence
rules.description: An unseen shell was followed by an unseen dual-use tool in the same container within the correlation window.

rules.name: Docker exec activity
rules.description: Docker exec activity occurred during the observation window.

rules.name: Privileged container configuration
rules.description: A container lifecycle event reported privileged mode during the observation window.

interpretation: Rules are deterministic evidence conditions. Severity estimates potential impact; confidence estimates evidence support. Neither is a probability of compromise.
